units.source_text: 这藤壶女御是桐壶院的藤壶女御的异母妹。

en.t: This Fujitsubo Consort was the younger half-sister of the Fujitsubo Consort of Kiritsubo-in.

units.source_text: 凡皇族降为臣下，赐姓都是源氏。

en.t: Whenever members of the imperial family were reduced to subject status, the surname bestowed on them was always Minamoto.
